address: 7940 West Drive, North Bay Village, FL 33141
amenitiesDescription:
Amenities span four dedicated levels: a ground-floor waterfront lobby with private marina, 240-foot Biscayne Bay boardwalk, pet spa, and butler service; a Level 8 residents' lounge with co-working, media room, library, and meditation garden; a Level 29 Waterfront Wellness floor with fitness center, Pilates and yoga studios, spa with sauna, steam, and private treatment rooms; and a rooftop 360° pool with hot tub, cold plunge, cabanas, and alfresco dining.

Beyond the building, residents access a branded Private Beach Club at Miami Beach, a Resident Yacht Club with reciprocal privileges in Monaco and Saint-Tropez, and Prestige Auto luxury vehicle management — all through the Pagani Residences mobile app.
architectQuote: Like a Pagani, every detail is resolved at a level most will never see — but everyone will feel.
description: Construction is underway on the world's first Pagani-branded residential tower. Seventy all-corner waterfront homes in North Bay Village, curated by Horacio Pagani and Pagani Arte, each delivered with bespoke Italian atelier interiors and an exclusive Pagani automotive sculpture.

investmentIntelligence.thesis: Pagani Residences is the purest expression of the collector-asset residential thesis: a brand so scarce it makes other luxury brands look mass-market, applied to an ultra-boutique building on Biscayne Bay. With construction now underway and the penthouses setting North Bay Village pricing records, the building has crossed the threshold from concept to certainty. The buyer here is not optimizing for yield — they are securing an address where access closes permanently once primary inventory is gone.

investmentThesis: The only residential project by Pagani Automobili, whose Huayra and Utopia hypercars are produced in editions of fewer than 100. Construction is now underway, with completion slated for 2027. The building applies the same bespoke philosophy as the cars: every residence is personalized through the Pagani atelier. The two duplex penthouses set North Bay Village pricing records at $30M and $28.5M. Eight purchasable guest suites and eight Pagani Paddock private garages add a collector dimension. Beyond the building, residents access a branded Private Beach Club on Miami Beach, a Resident Yacht Club with reciprocal privileges in Monaco and Saint-Tropez, and Prestige Auto luxury vehicle management — all through the Pagani Residences mobile app. Located in North Bay Village, a private island enclave minutes from Miami Beach, Wynwood, and the Design District.
name: Pagani Residences
residenceContent: The first residential development in the world curated by Pagani, the Italian hypercar manufacturer whose obsession with art, science, and craftsmanship now extends to 70 all-corner waterfront homes. Construction is underway on the 30-story tower, which features a 240-foot private Biscayne Bay boardwalk and marina. Two- to four-bedroom residences range from 2,000 to over 3,300 square feet with 11-foot ceilings, ensuite private elevators, and terraces from 800 to 1,040 square feet. Only four residences per floor. Two duplex penthouses crown the 28th and 29th floors, each up to 12,200 square feet with 13-foot ceilings and private rooftop pools. Every home is delivered fully finished and completely bespoke, with owners working directly with Pagani's atelier to personalize finishes, materials, and color palettes. Each residence includes an exclusive Pagani automotive sculpture and furniture from Pagani Arte. Eight purchasable guest suites and eight Pagani Paddock private garages are available for acquisition.
